fields.Name: T123 - Admin Users Management
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Identity & Access > Users sub-section loads and displays a grid of user records without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Identity & Access' section, then in its left sub-navigation make sure the 'Users' sub-section is selected. The success state is a grid of user records displayed in the main panel. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the grid to populate, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Identity & Access section open and a left sub-navigation listing Users, Roles, Apps, Permissions, etc.
The Users sub-section is selected and a grid of user records is visible in the main panel
The grid shows multiple user rows with columns of user data
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
